claims.claim: A New York homeowner paid a $70 permit fee after Tesla submitted a replacement application without payment for three Powerwalls deactivated in August.
claims.episode_span: A New York homeowner paid the $70 permit fee out of pocket after Tesla submitted the replacement application without payment. The three affected units, two Powerwall+ equipped with solar inverters and one Powerwall 2, had been deactivated in August.
claims.source_title: Tesla owner pays $70 permit fee company left unpaid after months with three disabled Powerwalls
claims.supporting_quote: A New York homeowner paid a $70 permit fee after discovering their installer had submitted paperwork for replacement batteries without payment.

claims.claim: The permit for the Powerwall replacement lists Powerwall 3 hardware.
claims.episode_span: The permit lists Powerwall 3 hardware as the replacement.
claims.source_title: Tesla owner pays $70 permit fee company left unpaid after months with three disabled Powerwalls
claims.supporting_quote: The permit detailed Powerwall 3s, meaning the homeowner would be getting their old Powerwalls replaced with an upgrade.

claims.claim: Tesla held first place in South Korea’s imported car market for the ninth consecutive month with 9,165 October registrations.
claims.episode_span: Tesla held first place in South Korea’s imported car market for the ninth consecutive month. October registrations reached 9,165 units, down 25.9 percent from the prior month yet still 29.5 percent of the imported segment.
claims.source_title: Tesla logo added to South Korean flag ... Musk celebrates Tesla’s No. 1 ranking in Korea
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla held on to first place in South Korea’s imported car market, beating Mercedes-Benz and BMW,” and that “October registrations surged 110.7% year over year to 9,165 units.”

claims.claim: EVgo opened its first Supercharger station in Chicago with 12 stalls offering both NACS and CCS plugs at 325 kW.
claims.episode_span: EVgo opened its first Supercharger station in a Chicago grocery store parking lot with 12 stalls offering both NACS and CCS plugs. The site at Riverside Square & River’s Edge on South Ashland Avenue features 325 kW chargers and Magic Dock technology.
claims.source_title: EVgo opens its first Tesla Superchargers, with hundreds more planned
claims.supporting_quote: EVgo has opened its first Supercharger station, and it’s in a Chicago grocery store parking lot. The site has 12 fast-charging stalls with both NACS and CCS plugs.

claims.claim: Starlink Router 4 now ships with V4 Kits on Residential 200 Mbps and Residential Max plans in the US and Canada with coverage up to 3,500 square feet.
claims.episode_span: Router 4 now ships with Starlink V4 Kits on Residential 200 Mbps and Residential Max plans in the US and Canada. The router supports indoor coverage up to 3,500 square feet for streaming, gaming and everyday home use.
claims.source_title: Starlink Ships Wi-Fi 7 Router 4 With V4 Kits in Canada and the US
claims.supporting_quote: Router 4 is now shipping with Starlink V4 Kits in the United States and Canada on Residential 200 Mbps and Residential Max plans.
